description: A PHPUnit test class 'GeneratorTest' for testing various features of the HTML generator component in the Daux documentation project. Contains methods testing page generation, analytics injection, sidebar links, landing pages, and raw pages.

classes.name: GeneratorTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the Generator component in Daux's HTML format.

methods.name: getDaux
methods.description: Initializes a virtual filesystem with sample markdown and other files, builds a Daux instance configured with these files, and generates the directory tree.

methods.name: testGenerateSinglePage
methods.description: Tests generating a single page, verifying the content contains navigation, breadcrumb, search, and navigation elements.

methods.name: testGenerateAnalytics
methods.description: Tests injecting analytics scripts into the generated page based on configuration.

methods.name: testGenerateSinglePageWithoutSearch
methods.description: Verifies that search-related elements are omitted when search is disabled in config.

methods.name: testGenerateSidebarLinks
methods.description: Checks that custom sidebar links and social media buttons are rendered correctly.

methods.name: testGenerateLandingPage
methods.description: Validates the generation of a landing page with links and buttons, including custom buttons and external links.

methods.name: testGenerateRawPage
methods.description: Ensures that raw files like SVGs are served correctly without modification.
